reviewer: Two independent agent source-review lanes; not human-certified accuracy.
method: Frozen 98 fact targets per model, one core-10 source-ambiguous target excluded consistently (97 scorable); 16 source-context-reviewed table rows per model. Exact one-fence handling and otherwise readable field-level sensitivity remain separate from original schema validity. Context, units and source associations required. Transcription-only presence is not a structured fact. Additional unscored errors are retained separately, so matching all references does not establish absence of errors.

document_reference_pass.limitation: Selected reference checks only; no absence-of-other-errors claim.
